summary: Purple Biotech Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 23, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the establishment of a Scientific Advisory Board (SAB) to support development of its CAPTN-3 tri-specific antibody platform. The SAB includes experts in NK and T-cell biology and T-cell engager therapies. No financial terms, transaction, or corporate action were disclosed. This filing is a routine press release regarding an ordinary business development, not a special situation. It is incorporated by reference into various registration statements. No deal terms, premium, or structural changes are involved. Nothing to watch from a risk-arb perspective.
